confirmation_source: Owner approval in session 2026-10-07 (Olivier Winter, repository and scientific owner) for the production W39 release. Neutral Linear/Full display with the range at the 1st-99th percentile of in-brain values for the single ephys-edges feature.
decision: Linear/Full, range at the 1st-99th percentile of in-brain values.
rationale: Edge strength is strictly positive with a right tail; a percentile range avoids saturation.
